name: @levent-kurt/git-autocommit
description: OpenCode plugin that automatically commits changes when your coding session becomes idle
author: levent-kurt

scripts.build: node -e "const ts = require('typescript'); const compilerOptions = { target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022, module: ts.ModuleKind.ESNext, moduleResolution: ts.ModuleResolutionKind.NodeJs, declaration: true, outDir: 'dist', rootDir: 'src', strict: true, esModuleInterop: true, skipLibCheck: true, types: ['node'], allowSyntheticDefaultImports: true, resolveJsonModule: true }; const program = ts.createProgram(['src/index.ts'], compilerOptions); program.emit(); "
